mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate above 4.5% within 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings slowdowns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market contraction, which precedes consumer demand slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing weakness that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in core CPI above 2.5% annually signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction with reduced job openings, preceding corporate earnings declines and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals rising consumer confidence that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during housing market recovery when HOUST increases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.
